description: Red tide (Karenia brevis) near a spot in Florida from FWC's own water samples of the last 8 days: the closest sample sites with FWC's words (not present/background, very low, low, medium, high), the sample day and miles away. Give a position, an FWC sample site or boat ramp name, or nothing for the statewide picture. Gives one sentence to say out loud. Never says a beach is safe.

place.description: Or part of an FWC sample site name (e.g. Siesta, Venice Pier) or a Florida boat ramp name
